heading: Thirty-two reports became two pages. Fifteen audiences became five.
summary: On 605 Impact, 32 separate reports collapsed into 2 pages; on 605 Platform, chart render time fell from 3–4 minutes to 1–1.5 minutes, and a comparison that took 30 minutes for two audiences and two metrics, or 1–2 hours for five audiences and four metrics, became one report.
source: April 2021 deck; timings from user walkthroughs.
